note: Kaifeng (Bianjing): Tang Bianzhou, the Northern Song triple-walled capital (Palace, Inner and Outer City) now 8-11 m under Yellow River silt after the 1642 flood, the Ming city and Prince of Zhou palace, and the Qing city whose wall (rebuilt 1841-43) survives. Song positions are reconstructed around the Ming-Qing wall and the Imperial Way (Zhongshan Road); treat Outer City corners and gates as estimates.
